pokedexEntries.rb: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

pokedexEntries.ye: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.

pokedexEntries.go: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

pokedexEntries.si: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.

pokedexEntries.cr: It travels by rolling on mountain paths. If it gains too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.

pokedexEntries.ru: GRAVELER grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This POKéMON eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.

pokedexEntries.fr: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.
